body:
## Release Notes: Disruption October 6, 2025 The Network360 Team is excited to share the latest updates designed to enhance your experience on the Disruption platform. ### What’s New in This Release? The Analysis page has been improved with several new features. Users will now receive email notifications once an analysis is complete, making it easier to stay updated. The system also supports a higher number of networks during analysis, offering greater flexibility. Additionally, the issue with exporting detailed analysis as a CSV file has been resolved. ### Key Highlights: **1. Added Viewing Selector to Filter the Analyses List** **What’s New:** On the Manage Disruption Analyses page, a Viewing dropdown has been added above the Analyses list, offering My Analyses and All Analyses as options. By default, My Analyses is selected.
![]()
**How This Helps:** Now you can switch between the analyses you ran and all the analyses that you can access. This provides easy access to view your Analyses. **2. Automated Email Notification on Analyses Completion** **What’s New:** When a Disruption analysis is completed, the system will automatically sends an email notification to the user who initiated the analysis. **How This Helps:** This feature improves user experience and workflow efficiency by notifying users via email when a Disruption analysis has completed processing. **3. Expanded Network Selection** **What’s New:** User can select unlimited networks (previously it was up to 5 networks). **How This Helps:** * Enables users to analyze an unlimited number of networks. * Improves visualization and PDF export capabilities to accommodate larger datasets effectively. **4. Fixed Export Detailed Analysis CSV** **What’s New:** Users can now download the Export Detailed Analysis CSV file even when the Analysis name includes numerical characters. **How This Helps:** Previously, if an Analysis was saved with a name containing numerical characters, the Export Detailed Analysis CSV option was disabled and could not be downloaded. With this release, the CSV export is now fully functional—even when the Analysis name includes numerical characters. ### Conclusion Recent updates to the Disruption Analyses feature include a new viewing selector that allows users to filter between their own analyses and all accessible ones, automated email notifications upon analysis completion to enhance workflow efficiency, and the ability to select an unlimited number of networks for analysis, improving data visualization and export capabilities. For more details, please don’t hesitate to reach out!
